cells.gaps: No source from the last three years naming a public body, system or product tested, audited or certified against the standards is held.
cells.note: Lei 1/2024 institutes the QNI's technical specifications (STP-001) and, as a law, makes the mandatory ones compulsory in new IT projects of public institutions (STP-002). Stage 5 needs a system checked against the specifications in the last three years, and none is held.
